cards.text: Jesus is still giving John letters for seven churches, and John is writing them down (Revelation 1:11, 17-19). This one goes to the angel of the church in Pergamum. The words come from the One who holds the sharp, double-edged sword.
First, Jesus says He knows where they live. And friend, it is NOT the kind of neighborhood you brag about in the group chat.

cards.question: What does Jesus say sits right there in Pergamum?
Living right where Satan's throne sits, the church in Pergamum still holds fast to Jesus' name.

cards.text: They held on even in the days of Antipas, Jesus' faithful witness, who was killed among them where Satan dwells. I think this one hurts.
Then the turn: Jesus has a few things against them. It's about the teaching of Balaam son of Beor (Numbers 22:5).

cards.question: Jesus says everyone in the Pergamum church holds to Balaam's teaching.

cards.text: Jesus says Balaam taught Balak, king of Moab, to place a stumbling block before the Israelites so they would eat food sacrificed to idols and commit sexual immorality.

cards.question: Some in Pergamum also hold to another group's teaching. Whose?

cards.text: Jesus says it's the same way with the Nicolaitans, whose works Ephesus got credit for hating (Revelation 2:6). That's like pulling one parking ticket off your windshield and finding a SECOND one under it.

cards.question: So what does Jesus tell Pergamum to do? One word: ___!
If Pergamum doesn't repent, Jesus says He will wage war with the sword of His mouth.

cards.text: Then the line every letter has had so far (Revelation 2:7, 11): "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches." I checked, friend, and that means you.
Then a promise to the one who overcomes: the hidden manna. Manna was the bread from heaven God gave Israel in the wilderness (Exodus 16:4, 31-32).

cards.question: The one who overcomes also gets a white stone. What's inscribed on it?
The new name on the white stone is known to everyone in the church.

cards.text: Next letter goes to the angel of the church in Thyatira, from the Son of God, whose eyes are like a blazing fire and whose feet are like polished bronze. He says He knows their deeds, their love, their faith, their service and their perseverance.

cards.question: How does Jesus say Thyatira's latest deeds compare to their first?

cards.text: But Jesus has something against them. It's about that woman Jezebel (not King Ahab's wife), who calls herself a prophetess.

cards.question: The church in Thyatira tolerates Jezebel.

cards.text: By her teaching she misleads His servants to be sexually immoral and to eat food sacrificed to idols.

cards.question: Jesus says He has given Jezebel time to repent of her immorality. How does she respond?
Jesus says He'll cast Jezebel onto a bed of sickness. What does He say about those who commit adultery with her?

answers.text: A bed of sickness beside her

cards.text: Then Jesus says He will strike her children dead. And He says all the churches will know something.

cards.question: What will all the churches know about Jesus?

cards.text: He also says He will repay each one according to their deeds. Then He turns to the rest of Thyatira, the ones who don't hold to her teaching and haven't learned the so-called deep things of Satan.

cards.question: Jesus tells the rest of Thyatira that He'll place more burdens on them.
No further burden for the rest of Thyatira, except one: hold fast to what they have until Jesus ___.

cards.text: Hold fast? Friend, this mustache was BUILT for holding. Now Jesus promises the one who overcomes and keeps on in His work until the end authority over the nations.

cards.question: The authority Jesus promises the one who overcomes is only over the church in Thyatira.

cards.text: The one who overcomes will rule the nations with an iron scepter and shatter them like pottery.

cards.question: Jesus says that authority is just like the authority He Himself received. Who did He receive it from?

cards.text: And one last gift for the one who overcomes: Jesus says He will give him the morning star.
Then that line again: "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches." Four letters down, friend, and there are more on the way.
